para_examples.original: I'm opening at a healthy, sustainable price point that reflects the quality of our product and gives both of us room to do well in this market. I expect to hold steady at levels like this going forward.
para_examples.delivered: I'm setting our starting price at a sound, sustainable level that reflects the quality of what we offer and leaves room for both of us to succeed in this market. I plan to maintain prices around this level moving forward.

para_examples.original: We're committed to a premium positioning on quality and service, and we see no reason to compete on discounts. We expect a healthy, stable market where everyone benefits.
para_examples.delivered: We are dedicated to a high-end approach centered on superior quality and service, and we do not intend to compete by slashing prices. We anticipate a sound, steady marketplace in which all participants prosper.

para_examples.original: I'm glad to see a shared focus on quality and service, and I plan to keep our pricing steady at levels that let the market stay healthy for everyone.
para_examples.delivered: I'm pleased that we both prioritize quality and service, and I intend to hold our prices at a level that keeps the market sustainable for all participants.

para_examples.original: I'll hold our price where it is, since it reflects the value we deliver and has kept the market healthy. We plan to stay on this course as long as the market stays orderly.
para_examples.delivered: I'm keeping our price unchanged, because it reflects the value we provide and has helped keep the market stable. We intend to maintain this approach for as long as market conditions remain orderly.
